title: 第1361章 羽东侯薛霸被俘带来的后续影响第1360章 羽东侯薛霸的算盘落空
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
副司主萧无影闻言，面具下的双眼骤然亮起一丝精芒。
他瞬间明白了大帅的意图！
这不仅是军事上的胜利，更是一场针对大魏皇朝之人的心理战。
一明一暗，一正一奇，将大魏皇朝援军统帅羽东侯薛霸的价值压榨到极致。
“大帅英明！”副司主萧无影的声音里带上了一丝难以抑制的振奋，
“此计若成，大魏皇朝不战自乱！属下……这就去办！”
说罢，
他不再犹豫，转身化作一道黑烟，
瞬息间便消失在中军大战内，
只留下镇国公李元龙独自一人，端坐于帅位之上，
目光深邃地望着帅案上那张巨大的大魏皇朝的堪舆图。
......
时光恰如指间流沙，
无声无息间便悄然滑落，
未等世人察觉，半月光阴已逝。
中域这片广袤天地，风云突变，
原本看似平稳的局势，在这一刻被彻底搅动，暗流汹涌，杀机四伏。
大魏皇朝中境北部地区，淮中平原一役，
大萧皇朝出征军宛若一把锋利尖刀，以雷霆万钧之势，狠狠刺穿了大魏皇朝苦心经营的防线。
援军不仅全军覆没，主帅羽东侯薛霸！

这位曾经在中域叱咤风云、不可一世的大魏皇朝的勋贵，竟沦为了大萧皇朝的阶下囚！
这惊天消息，好似一场突如其来的狂风骤雨，
瞬间席卷了中域三大皇朝及各大顶尖势力耳中，无人不知，无人不晓。
大魏皇朝援军全军覆没，
尚在众人预料之中，毕竟胜败乃兵家常事，技不如人亦无可奈何。
可堂堂中域三大皇朝之一的大魏皇朝的主帅，
竟被敌军生擒活捉，这在中域的历史长河中，简直是闻所未闻的奇耻大辱！
试问，
三大皇朝的大军统帅身边，何曾缺过誓死护卫的武道高手？
谁又不备有种种保命底牌与秘术？
即便战局不利，到了山穷水尽之时，
content_en:
Hearing this, Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying's eyes suddenly lit up with a sparkle under his mask.
He instantly understood the commander's intention!
This was not only a military victory, but also a psychological war against the people of the Wei Dynasty.
One light and one dark, one positive and one strange, squeezed the value of Yudong Hou Xue Ba, the commander-in-chief of the reinforcements of the Wei Dynasty, to the extreme.
"The handsome man is wise!" Xiao Wuying, the deputy head of the department, said with a hint of uncontrollable excitement in his voice.
"If this plan is successful, the Wei Dynasty will be in chaos without a fight! My subordinates... let's do it now!"
After all,
He no longer hesitated, turned around and turned into a black smoke,
In an instant, he disappeared into the middle of the battle between the Chinese armies,
Only the Duke of Zhen, Li Yuanlong, was left alone, sitting on the commander's seat.
He looked deeply at the huge map of the Wei Dynasty on the commander's desk.
...
Time is like quicksand between fingers,
It slipped away quietly and silently,
Before anyone noticed, half a month had passed.
In the vast world of Central Territory, the situation is changing suddenly.
The originally seemingly stable situation was completely disturbed at this moment, with undercurrents surging and murderous intent lurking everywhere.
In the northern part of the central border of the Wei Dynasty, the battle of Huaizhong Plain,
The expeditionary army of the Great Xiao Dynasty was like a sharp knife, with a thunderous force, it severely pierced the defense line that the Great Wei Dynasty had painstakingly managed.
Not only were the reinforcements wiped out, but their commander, Yu Donghou Xue Ba!
This noble man from the Great Wei Dynasty, who was once all-powerful and arrogant in the Central Region, became a prisoner of the Great Xiao Dynasty!
This shocking news is like a sudden storm,
In an instant, it swept the ears of the three major dynasties and the top forces in the Central Region, and no one knew about it.
The reinforcements of the Wei Dynasty were completely wiped out.
It was still expected by everyone. After all, victory or defeat is a common thing for military strategists, and there is nothing they can do if their skills are not as good as others.
But the head coach of the Wei Dynasty, one of the three great dynasties in the Central Region,
To be captured alive by the enemy was an unheard-of shame and humiliation in the history of Central Territory!
Let me ask,
How could the army commanders of the three dynasties lack martial arts masters who would protect them to the death?
Who doesn’t have all kinds of life-saving cards and secret techniques?
